package.name: omni_catch
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 30): the catch path and the play-catch behavior, robot code with no sim in it. catch_perception (camera frames -> color-blob detector -> drag-aware ballistic filter on the MCU's odometry), catch_behavior (predict, intercept, tilt, catch, aim, return), mode_manager (IDLE / TELEOP / CATCH, kid profile). The cores (perception.py, game.py, modes.py ...) have no ROS in them; the sim's harness runs them directly.
